titles.text: The Dot-com Bubble: How "Get Big Fast" Ended in a 78% Crash
5,048.62: The Number That Ended the Dot-com Boom
Why Did the Nasdaq Lose 78% After March 2000?

summary: On March 10, 2000, the Nasdaq Composite peaked at 5,048.62. By October 2002 it had lost 78%. This short documentary traces how the dot-com era's "get big fast" strategy met reality, using daily Nasdaq data and contemporary reporting.
